description: This source file defines data structures related to usage cost data, including totals, daily summaries, and overall summaries, along with utility functions for formatting and a loader for asynchronously fetching the summary data.

methods.name: formatUsd
methods.description: Formats a Double value into USD currency string with appropriate decimal places.

methods.name: formatTokenCount
methods.description: Formats an integer token count into a human-readable string with units (k, m).

methods.name: loadSummary
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the usage cost summary by requesting data from a control channel and decoding it into a GatewayCostUsageSummary instance.
